a.text: Detmer won the Heisman Trophy while playing quarterback for BYU.

b.text: Detmer's 1990 junior season ranks as one of the greatest seasons for a quarterback in college football history.

a.text: Detmer's tenure as offensive coordinator at BYU ended.

b.text: Detmer was released from the coordinator position.

a.text: Detmer was a late-round pick in the 1992 NFL Draft.

b.text: The Green Bay Packers drafted Detmer in the ninth round of the 1992 NFL Draft.

a.text: The 1991 season started poorly for BYU.

b.text: Detmer passed for 350 yards to lead BYU to a 13–13 tie against #7 Iowa in the 1991 Holiday Bowl.

a.text: Detmer signed a free-agent contract with the Philadelphia Eagles.

b.text: The Eagles posted a 7–4 record with Detmer as the starter during the 1996 season.
